title: Quaint Fluffy Tunisian Lamb Toast
description: A salty and fluffy Tunisian dish featuring parsley and lamb, perfect for a special occasion, and is keto friendly.

ingredients.name: lamb shoulder
ingredients.notes: boneless and cut into small pieces

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together lamb, parsley, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk together almond flour and eggs.
Add the almond flour mixture to the lamb mixture and mix well.
Divide the mixture into 4 equal parts and shape into patties.
Place the patties on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20 minutes or until the lamb is cooked through.
While the lamb is cooking, toast the bread slices.
Assemble the dish by placing a lamb patty on each toast slice.
